reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: Section 9.4(a) gives Ono the right 'but not the obligation' to Manufacture, and 9.4(b)/(b)(i) frame supply as Ono's 'right to obtain' with Array bound to supply 'Ono's reasonable requirements' — no take-or-pay, minimum volume, binding forecast or shortfall penalty on our party.

Rationale correctly characterises the Diligent Efforts diligence duties (5.1(b)(iii)/8.1(a)) as commercialization standards rather than volume commitments, and correctly declines to double-flag the Section 8.2 exclusivity covenant, which is handled under the exclusivity rule.
The only 'shortfall' hit is a royalty reconciliation true-up, which is consistent with (not contrary to) the playbook's preferred true-up mechanic; no deterministic check failures.
No redline is required or proposed, so there is no risk of over-flagging or of an invalid/directionally wrong edit.
